source.english_context: Unit 17 Laundry and Laundromats Goal: wash clothes outside the home, ask for help, and understand machine and payment words. Daily Life English Which machine is available? How much is one wash? Do I need quarters or a laundry card? My clothes are still wet. Where can I buy detergent? Is this washer out of order? Which cycle is best for delicate clothes? Can I use cold water for this load? How long does the wash cycle take? Where do I add the detergent? Does this dryer accept a card? Can I get change for a dollar? Someone's clothes are still in this machine. Is there a table for folding clothes? I think I left a sock in the dryer. Vocabulary laundromat a place with washing machines and dryers wash cycle the washing program on a machine dryer a machine that dries clothes detergent soap for washing clothes quarters 25-cent coins lint trap the screen that catches cloth dust in a dryer washer a machine that washes clothes load the clothes washed or dried together at one time delicate cycle a gentle washing program for easily damaged clothes fabric softener a product used to make washed clothes feel softer fold bend clothing neatly so it takes up less space out of order not working and not available to use US Customs Do not leave clothes in a machine for a long time after it stops. Clean the lint trap before or after using a dryer if the machine has one. Some apartments have shared laundry rooms with posted hours and rules. Check the posted payment instructions before loading a machine. A laundry room may use coins, a card, or an app. Set a timer so you know when your cycle ends. Take your clothes out promptly when other people are waiting. Keep folding tables and walkways clear of bags and baskets. Leave shared surfaces ready for the next person to use. If a machine stops or takes your payment without starting, note its number and ask staff how to report the problem. Dialogue Student: Excuse me, how do I pay for this washer? Staff: Use the laundry card machine by the door. Student: How much is one wash? Staff: It is $3.25. The dryer is separate. Student: Thank you. Which cycle should I use for regular clothes? Staff: Check the clothing labels. The machine instructions are above the buttons. Student: How long does the regular cycle take? Staff: About thirty minutes. The screen shows the time remaining. Student: I will set a timer so I can collect my clothes promptly. Staff: Thank you. The folding tables are beside the dryers.

japanese_explanation.heading: 共有の洗濯では時間とマナーが大切
points: ランドリーでは、機械が止まったら早めに服を取り出します。他の人が待っていることがあります。
支払い方法は場所によって違います。硬貨、カード、アプリ、専用ランドリーカードなどがあります。
乾燥機では lint trap を確認します。ほこりを取ると乾きやすくなり、火事の危険も下がります。
japanese_explanation.practice: Do I need quarters or a laundry card?

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 共用洗衣要注意时间和礼貌
points: 在自助洗衣店或公寓洗衣房，机器停了以后要尽快取出衣服，因为别人可能在等。
付款方式每个地方不同，可能用硬币、银行卡、App或专用洗衣卡。
使用烘干机时要注意 lint trap。清理绒毛会让衣服更容易干，也能降低火灾风险。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: Do I need quarters or a laundry card?

ko.heading: 공용 세탁 시 시간과 에티켓 준수가 중요합니다
points: 세탁기 작동이 멈추면 다른 사람이 기다리고 있을 수 있으므로 옷을 신속하게 꺼내세요.
결제 방법은 장소에 따라 다릅니다. 동전, 카드, 앱, 전용 세탁 카드 등이 있습니다.
건조기 사용 시 보푸라기 필터(lint trap)를 확인하세요. 보푸라기를 제거하면 건조가 더 잘 되고 화재 위험도 줄어듭니다.

points: 在自助洗衣店或公寓洗衣房，机器停了以后要尽快取出衣服，因为别人可能在等。
付款方式每个地方不同，可能用硬币、银行卡、App或专用洗衣卡。
使用烘干机时要注意 lint trap。清理绒毛会让衣服更容易干，也能降低火灾风险。

es.heading: En la lavandería compartida, el tiempo y la cortesía son importantes
points: En la lavandería, cuando la máquina se detenga, retire la ropa rápidamente. Otras personas pueden estar esperando.
Los métodos de pago varían según el lugar. Puede haber monedas, tarjetas, aplicaciones o tarjetas de lavandería dedicadas.
En la secadora, revise el lint trap (filtro de pelusas). Quitar las pelusas ayuda a que la ropa se seque más fácilmente y reduce el riesgo de incendio.

pt-BR.heading: Em lavanderias compartilhadas, o tempo e a etiqueta são importantes
points: Na lavanderia, retire suas roupas rapidamente assim que a máquina parar. Outras pessoas podem estar esperando.
Os métodos de pagamento variam conforme o local. Pode-se usar moedas, cartões, aplicativos ou cartões de lavanderia específicos.
Ao usar a secadora, verifique o lint trap (filtro de fiapos). Remover os fiapos ajuda a secar a roupa mais facilmente e reduz o risco de incêndio.

fr.heading: Dans les laveries partagées, le temps et les bonnes manières sont essentiels
points: À la laverie, retirez vos vêtements rapidement une fois que la machine s'arrête. D'autres personnes peuvent attendre.
Les méthodes de paiement varient selon les endroits. Il peut s'agir de pièces de monnaie, de cartes, d'applications ou de cartes de laverie dédiées.
Dans le sèche-linge, vérifiez le filtre à peluches (lint trap). Retirer les peluches facilite le séchage et réduit le risque d’incendie.

de.heading: In Gemeinschaftswaschküchen sind Zeit und Etikette wichtig
points: Entnehmen Sie Ihre Kleidung in der Waschküche zügig, sobald die Maschine angehalten hat. Es könnten andere Personen warten.
Die Zahlungsmethoden variieren je nach Ort. Es kann Münzen, Karten, Apps oder spezielle Wäschekarten geben.
Überprüfen Sie im Trockner das Flusensieb (lint trap). Das Entfernen von Fusseln erleichtert das Trocknen und reduziert das Brandrisiko.
